name: How do I choose the right contractor for my bonus room addition?
description: Choose a contractor based on experience, portfolio, references, licensing, insurance, and their ability to communicate clearly and manage local building codes.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my bonus room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience with similar projects, reviewing their portfolio, and checking references. It's crucial to select a company that is licensed and insured in California, like Hometelligent Inc. Look for a contractor who offers transparent communication, provides detailed proposals, and understands local building codes specific to your area, such as Piedmont or Hayward, to ensure a smooth project.
